#### Manipulability and a patient's sex

"What is the effect of a smoking-cessation program on lung cancer risk?"
names an intervention that can be assigned,
so it fits the manipulability account.

"What is the effect of a patient's sex on lung cancer risk?"
does not name an intervention.
On this account the question is not well posed
until we say which intervention is meant.

:::
